s0301.literal: Gold, silver, silk currency, and cloth were granted to the princes according to the annual precedent.
s0301.idiomatic: The princes received gold, silver, silk currency, and cloth according to annual custom.

s0302.literal: In the fifth year, spring, first month, on jiawu day, the moon encroached on Jing.
s0302.idiomatic: In the fifth year, on jiawu day in the first month of spring, the moon passed through Jing.

s0303.literal: On gengzi day, a City God temple was built at Shangdu.
s0303.idiomatic: On gengzi day a City God temple was built at Shangdu.

s0304.literal: On xinchou day, an edict ordered the five circuits of Shaanxi and the Sichuan Branch Secretariat to build five hundred war vessels and deliver them to Liu Zheng.
s0304.idiomatic: On xinchou day an edict ordered Shaanxi's five circuits and the Sichuan branch secretariat to build five hundred war vessels for Liu Zheng.

s0305.literal: King Wang Chon of Goryeo sent his younger brother Cheo to court.
s0305.idiomatic: King Wang Chon of Goryeo sent his younger brother Cheo to court.

s0306.literal: An edict stated that Chon had tried to deceive with polished words; the emperor confronted Cheo face to face with the facts and sharply rebuked him.
s0306.idiomatic: An edict charged that Chon had deceived them with polished rhetoric; the emperor confronted Cheo directly with the facts and sharply rebuked him.

s0307.literal: Yeyasutai, Route-intendant of Beiping, and Meng Jia, Section Director in the Ministry of Rites, were again dispatched to carry an edict and instruct them, ordering them to submit a memorial and send Prince Haiyang Jin Jun and Vice Minister Li Zangyong to return with the departing envoys and report.
s0307.idiomatic: Yeyasutai, intendant of Beiping route, and Meng Jia of the Ministry of Rites were sent again with an edict instructing Goryeo to submit a memorial and dispatch Prince Haiyang Jin Jun and Vice Minister Li Zangyong to return with the outgoing envoys and report.

s0308.literal: On gengxu day, a new calendar was granted to Goryeo.
s0308.idiomatic: On gengxu day a new calendar was granted to Goryeo.

s0309.literal: In the intercalary month, on wuwu day, garrison-farming households at Chen, Bo, Ying, Cai and other posts were conscripted as soldiers;
s0309.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on wuwu day, garrison-farming households at Chen, Bo, Ying, Cai, and other posts were drafted as soldiers;

s0310.literal: Four thousand unregistered households in Yidu were ordered to pan gold at Qixia County in Dengzhou; each household was to deliver four qian of gold annually.
s0310.idiomatic: Four thousand unregistered Yidu households were ordered to pan for gold at Qixia County in Dengzhou, each to deliver four qian of gold per year.

s0311.literal: Second month, on wuzi day, the moon encroached on Tianguan.
s0311.idiomatic: In the second month, on wuzi day, the moon passed through Tianguan.

s0312.literal: On jichou day, the moon encroached on Jing.
s0312.idiomatic: On jichou day the moon passed through Jing.

s0313.literal: Notes were issued to impoverished soldiers in Henan and Shandong.
s0313.idiomatic: Notes were distributed to impoverished soldiers in Henan and Shandong.

s0314.literal: On wuxu day, the Armaments Bureau was changed to the Armaments Directorate.
s0314.idiomatic: On wuxu day the Armaments Bureau was renamed the Armaments Directorate.

s0315.literal: On xinchou day, centurion Qundusu had been encamped in counties subordinate to Jinan Route for three years.
s0315.idiomatic: On xinchou day centurion Qundusu, who had been encamped in Jinan route counties for three years,

s0316.literal: He had extorted from the people provisions worth five thousand shi of grain; an edict ordered him beaten with the staff, and he was still required to repay one thousand shi of grain.
s0316.idiomatic: had extorted from the people provisions worth five thousand shi of grain; an edict ordered him beaten with the staff and still required to repay one thousand shi of grain.

s0317.literal: Suzhou in Ganzhou Route was split off as its own route.
s0317.idiomatic: Ganzhou route's Suzhou was separated as its own route.

s0318.literal: Third month, on bingyin day, hostages who were descendants of officials below the fourth rank in all routes were released.
s0318.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingyin day, hostages held from among descendants of officials below fourth rank in all routes were released.

s0319.literal: Tian Yu spread heterodox talk; an edict commuted his death sentence to exile to a distant place.
s0319.idiomatic: Tian Yu spread seditious talk; an edict reduced his death sentence to exile to a distant region.

s0320.literal: Private weapons among the people were forbidden; offenders were sentenced according to the quantity found.
s0320.idiomatic: Private arms among the people were forbidden; offenders were sentenced according to the number seized.

s0321.literal: On jiazi day, an edict ordered Qiemian to lead two thousand troops to summon and persuade Jiandu.
s0321.idiomatic: On jiazi day an edict ordered Qiemian to lead two thousand troops to summon and persuade Jiandu.

s0322.literal: On renshen day, Wuzhangdeshan was renamed Dingyuan Fortress, and Wuqunshan was renamed Wusheng Army.
s0322.idiomatic: On renshen day Wuzhangdeshan was renamed Dingyuan Fortress and Wuqunshan Wusheng Army.

s0323.literal: On dingchou day, an edict ordered Ali and others to go to the front to inspect the military registers.
s0323.idiomatic: On dingchou day an edict ordered Ali and others to the front to inspect the military rolls.

s0324.literal: Jurchen, Khitan, and Han darughachi in all routes were removed; Muslim, Uyghur, Naiman, and Tangut appointees remained as before.
s0324.idiomatic: Jurchen, Khitan, and Han route overseers in all circuits were removed; Muslim, Uyghur, Naiman, and Tangut appointees stayed in place.

s0325.literal: Summer, fourth month, on renyin day, envoys were dispatched to sacrifice to the mountains and rivers.
s0325.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on renyin day, envoys were sent to sacrifice to the mountains and rivers.

s0326.literal: Fifth month, first day on xinhai, the Imperial Medical Academy, Archery Guard Office, Music Office, and the Food, Fruit, and Wine bureaus were placed under the Privy Office of the Imperial Household.
s0326.idiomatic: On the xinhai new moon of the fifth month, the Imperial Medical Academy, Archery Guard Office, Music Office, and the Food, Fruit, and Wine bureaus were placed under the Privy Office of the Imperial Household.

s0327.literal: On guihai day, Grand Marshal Baiyanu captured the three Song garrisons of Wuhua, Shicheng, and Baima at Jiading.
s0327.idiomatic: On guihai day Grand Marshal Baiyanu took the three Song strongholds of Wuhua, Shicheng, and Baima at Jiading.

s0328.literal: On guiyou day, sixty thousand bolts of silk currency were granted to Princes Hehu and Balaqai.
s0328.idiomatic: On guiyou day Princes Hehu and Balaqai received sixty thousand bolts of silk currency.

s0329.literal: Sixth month, first day on xinsi, Wang Baohe of Jinan deluded the masses with heterodox talk and plotted rebellion; an edict executed the five ringleaders and took no further action against the rest.
s0329.idiomatic: On the xinsi new moon of the sixth month, Wang Baohe of Jinan deluded the people with seditious talk and plotted rebellion; an edict executed the five ringleaders and took no further action against the rest.

s0330.literal: On jiashen day, Zhongshan had a great hailstorm.
s0330.idiomatic: On jiashen day Zhongshan suffered a major hailstorm.

s0331.literal: Aju said: "The troops I command are Mongol; when encountering mountain-and-water stockades, Han troops are indispensable.
s0331.idiomatic: Aju said, "The force I command is Mongol; in mountain-and-water stockades Han troops are indispensable.

s0332.literal: Shi Shu should be ordered to lead Han troops to join forces and advance the campaign.
s0332.idiomatic: Shi Shu should be ordered to lead Han troops in joint advance.

s0334.literal: On wushen day, locusts afflicted Dongping and other places.
s0334.idiomatic: On wushen day locusts struck Dongping and other places.

s0335.literal: On jiyou day, Prince Xilieji was enfeoffed as Prince of Heeping and granted a gold seal with a camel knob.
s0335.idiomatic: On jiyou day Prince Xilieji was made Prince of Heeping and given a gold seal with a camel knob.

s0336.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on xinhai day, Hanlin Attending Academician Gao Ming, Shunzhou Prefect Liu Yu, and the Zhongdu scholars Hao Qian, Li Tianfu, Han Yanwen, and Li You were summoned to Shangdu; Shandong Deputy Army Commander Wang Zhongren was assigned to garrison Meizhou.
s0336.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinhai day, Gao Ming, Hanlin attending academician; Liu Yu, prefect of Shunzhou; and the Zhongdu scholars Hao Qian, Li Tianfu, Han Yanwen, and Li You were summoned to Shangdu; Shandong deputy army commander Wang Zhongren was posted to garrison Meizhou.

s0337.literal: On renzi day, an edict ordered the Shaanxi Army Command also to oversee military and civilian revenue and grain.
s0337.idiomatic: On renzi day an edict put the Shaanxi army command in charge of military and civilian revenues and grain as well.

s0338.literal: Auruq officials in all circuits were abolished; civilian administrators were ordered to assume their duties.
s0338.idiomatic: Auruq officials in all circuits were abolished, and civilian administrators were ordered to take over their duties.

s0339.literal: On guichou day, the Censorate was established, with Right Grand Councillor Tachar as Censor-in-Chief; an edict instructed him: "The duty of censorial officials is forthright speech. If I am ever in error, speak without reserve and fear no one—I will be your patron.
s0339.idiomatic: On guichou day the Censorate was established, with Right Grand Councillor Tachar as censor-in-chief; an edict told him, "Censorial officials exist to speak plainly. If I am wrong, speak without reserve and fear no one—I will stand behind you.

s0340.literal: The instruction was also promulgated to the realm by edict.
s0340.idiomatic: The same message was promulgated to the realm by edict.

s0341.literal: Two postal stations north of Gaozhou were established.
s0341.idiomatic: Two relay stations north of Gaozhou were established.

s0342.literal: On wuchen day, the Xixia Pacification Commission was abolished.
s0342.idiomatic: On wuchen day the Xixia pacification commission was abolished.

s0343.literal: On gengwu day, the route-level directorates of hunting, hawking, workshops, and mining were abolished; transport offices were ordered to assume oversight.
s0343.idiomatic: On gengwu day route-level directorates for hunting, hawking, crafts, and mining were abolished, and transport offices were ordered to take them over.

s0344.literal: On bingzi day, a Public Benevolence Bureau was established in Xixia.
s0344.idiomatic: On bingzi day a public-benefit medicine bureau was established in Xixia.

s0345.literal: King Wang Chon of Goryeo sent his minister Cui Dongxiu to report that ten thousand troops were being prepared and one thousand ships built.
s0345.idiomatic: King Wang Chon of Goryeo sent his minister Cui Dongxiu to report preparations of ten thousand troops and one thousand ships.

s0346.literal: An edict sent Commander-in-Chief Tuoduo'er to inspect them, and while there to survey the Black Mountain route to Japan; Tamna was also ordered to build separately one hundred ships for deployment when needed.
s0346.idiomatic: An edict sent commander-in-chief Tuoduo'er to inspect them and survey the Black Mountain route to Japan; Tamna was also ordered to build a separate hundred ships for deployment when needed.

s0347.literal: An edict ordered Saiyid Ajall of the Sichuan Branch Secretariat to return from Lizhou to Jingzhao; Eastern and Western Chuan army commands were established, with Liu Zheng as Grand Marshal to deliberate on military affairs jointly with Grand Marshal Aju.
s0347.idiomatic: An edict ordered Saiyid Ajall of the Sichuan branch secretariat to return from Lizhou to Jingzhao; eastern and western Chuan army commands were established, with Liu Zheng as grand marshal to consult on military affairs jointly with Grand Marshal Aju.

s0348.literal: When Liu Zheng reached the army, he proposed building fortifications at Baihekou and Lumen Mountain; he sent envoys to report, and approval was granted.
s0348.idiomatic: When Liu Zheng reached the army he proposed fortifications at Baihekou and Lumen Mountain, reported by envoy, and approval was granted.

s0349.literal: Military advisory posts in the armies were abolished.
s0349.idiomatic: Advisory posts attached to field armies were abolished.

s0350.literal: Eighth month, on yiyou day, Cheng Sibin was executed for submitting an anonymous letter that reviled the imperial carriage.
s0350.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yiyou day, Cheng Sibin was executed for submitting an anonymous letter reviling the emperor's person.

s0351.literal: On jichou day, Bozhou suffered major flooding.
s0351.idiomatic: On jichou day Bozhou suffered major flooding.

s0352.literal: On gengzi day, an edict ordered ten granaries built along the river at the capital.
s0352.idiomatic: On gengzi day an edict ordered ten granaries built along the river at the capital.

s0353.literal: Mangudai was ordered to lead six thousand troops to campaign against Xifan and Jiandu.
s0353.idiomatic: Mangudai was ordered to lead six thousand troops against Xifan and Jiandu.

s0354.literal: Ninth month, on guichou day, Zhongdu Route was flooded; this year's land tax was remitted.
s0354.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guichou day, Zhongdu route was flooded; this year's land tax was remitted.

s0355.literal: The Zhongdu Route labor-requisition office was abolished.
s0355.idiomatic: The Zhongdu route labor-requisition office was abolished.

s0356.literal: On dingsi day, Aju commanded troops to besiege Fancheng.
s0356.idiomatic: On dingsi day Aju besieged Fancheng.

s0357.literal: An edict ordered Changchun Palace to conduct a seven-day-and-night Golden Register grand cosmic jiao ritual.
s0357.idiomatic: An edict ordered Changchun Palace to hold a seven-day-and-night Golden Register grand cosmic jiao.

s0358.literal: A temple to Yao and the Houtu Taining Palace were built.
s0358.idiomatic: A temple to Yao and the Houtu Taining Palace were built.

s0359.literal: On gengshen day, brocades were granted to King Chen Guangbing of Annam, and his ministers in varying amounts.
s0359.idiomatic: On gengshen day brocades were granted to King Chen Guangbing of Annam and his ministers in varying amounts.

s0360.literal: On jichou day, Henan garrison farming was established.
s0360.idiomatic: On jichou day Henan garrison farming was established.

s0361.literal: Hei'de, Vice Minister of War, and Yin Hong, Vice Minister of Rites, were ordered to carry the state letter on another mission to Japan; Goryeo was also instructed to provide guides and escort, with the goal of certain arrival and no repeat of the previous delays.
s0361.idiomatic: Hei'de, vice minister of war, and Yin Hong, vice minister of rites, were ordered to carry the state letter on another mission to Japan; Goryeo was also told to provide guides and escort, with certain arrival expected and no repeat of previous delays.

s0362.literal: An edict addressed Chen Guangbing of Annam: "Your memorial states that Champa and Chenla are raiding; you have already been ordered to mobilize troops and join Bugan in concerted suppression; now Prince Hugachi of Yunnan is further ordered to lead troops south. Follow the earlier edict: wherever rebels refuse allegiance and become border raiders, send troops to advance together; treat those who submit with good governance.
s0362.idiomatic: An edict to Chen Guangbing of Annam read, "Your memorial reports raids by Champa and Chenla; you have already been ordered to mobilize and join Bugan in joint suppression; Prince Hugachi of Yunnan is now further ordered south with troops. Follow the earlier edict: wherever rebels refuse allegiance and become border raiders, send troops together; treat those who submit with good governance.

s0363.literal: The imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.

s0364.literal: Yidu Route suffered famine; three hundred eighteen thousand shi of rice were distributed in relief.
s0364.idiomatic: Yidu route suffered famine; three hundred eighteen thousand shi of rice were distributed in relief.

s0365.literal: Shi Tianze was again appointed Vice Director of the Military Council.
s0365.idiomatic: Shi Tianze was again made vice director of the Military Council.

s0366.literal: Winter, tenth month, first day on wuyin; there was a solar eclipse.
s0366.idiomatic: On the wuyin new moon of the tenth month of winter, there was a solar eclipse.

s0367.literal: On jimao day, an edict ordered the Central Secretariat and Military Council to present all business jointly with censorial officials.
s0367.idiomatic: On jimao day an edict ordered the Central Secretariat and Military Council to present all business jointly with censorial officials.

s0368.literal: A branch secretariat for Henan and other routes was established, with Vice Grand Councillor Ali administering branch secretariat affairs.
s0368.idiomatic: A branch secretariat for Henan and other routes was established, with Vice Grand Councillor Ali to run branch secretariat affairs.

s0369.literal: On gengchen day, Censor Vice-in-Chief Ali was appointed Vice Grand Councillor.
s0369.idiomatic: On gengchen day Censor Vice-in-Chief Ali was made vice grand councillor.

s0370.literal: On renwu day, an edict showed concern for frontier armies; irregular extra levies were charged to auruq officials for reimbursement.
s0370.idiomatic: On renwu day an edict extended relief to frontier armies; irregular extra levies were charged to auruq officials for reimbursement.

s0371.literal: On gengyin day, an edict ordered the attendant minister Tuhusi and others to compile editions of the Book of Odes, Mencius, and Analects.
s0371.idiomatic: On gengyin day an edict ordered attendant minister Tuhusi and others to compile the Book of Odes, Mencius, and Analects.

s0372.literal: On yiwei day, sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0372.idiomatic: On yiwei day sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0373.literal: Central Secretariat officials said: "Past dynasties always kept daily records, so worthy policies and fine counsels were not lost.
s0373.idiomatic: Central Secretariat officials said, "Past courts always kept daily records, so worthy policies and fine counsels were not lost.

s0374.literal: He Lihesun and Duhula were thereupon appointed Hanlin Attending Academicians concurrently as recorders of daily events.
s0374.idiomatic: He Lihesun and Duhula were thereupon made Hanlin attending academicians concurrently as recorders of daily events.

s0375.literal: An edict granted farmland to newly submitted people of Li, Ya, and Jiading.
s0375.idiomatic: An edict granted farmland to newly submitted people of Li, Ya, and Jiading.

s0376.literal: On wuxu day, the palace city was completed.
s0376.idiomatic: On wuxu day the palace city was completed.

s0377.literal: Liu Bingzhong resigned his charge of Central Secretariat affairs; permission was granted, and he remained Grand Preceptor as before.
s0377.idiomatic: Liu Bingzhong resigned charge of Central Secretariat affairs; permission was granted, and he remained grand preceptor as before.

s0378.literal: Eleventh month, on jiyou day, registered households of various categories along the Henan and Shandong border fortifications were drafted as soldiers.
s0378.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiyou day, registered households of various categories along the Henan and Shandong border fortifications were drafted as soldiers.

s0379.literal: On gengshen day, Song troops from Xiangyang attacked the mountain garrisons; Aju divided his forces to resist, killing and capturing many; one thousand three hundred four officers and soldiers won merit.
s0379.idiomatic: On gengshen day Song troops from Xiangyang attacked the mountain garrisons; Aju divided his forces to resist, killing and capturing many; one thousand three hundred four officers and soldiers won merit.

s0380.literal: An edict granted fifty taels of silver each to those who first established battle merit by capturing enemy troops alive; other rewards varied.
s0380.idiomatic: An edict granted fifty taels of silver each to those who first won battle merit by capturing enemy troops alive; other rewards varied.

s0381.literal: On guiyou day, Censorate officials reported: "Since establishment several months ago, many cases have been exposed; nearly two hundred thousand shi of misappropriated grain have been recovered, with money and goods in proportion.
s0381.idiomatic: On guiyou day censorate officials reported, "In the few months since establishment many cases have been exposed; nearly two hundred thousand shi of misappropriated grain have been recovered, with money and goods in proportion.

s0382.literal: An edict praised and commended them.
s0382.idiomatic: An edict praised and commended them.

s0383.literal: Laborers for next year's capital construction from Nanjing and Henan routes were exempted.
s0383.idiomatic: Laborers for next year's capital construction from Nanjing and Henan routes were exempted.

s0384.literal: Twelfth month, on wuyin day, because of major floods at Zhongdu, Jinan, Yidu, Zilai, Hejian, Dongping, Nanjing, Shuntian, Shunde, Zhending, Enzhou, Gaotang, Jizhou, Beiping and other places, this year's land tax was remitted.
s0384.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuyin day, because of major floods at Zhongdu, Jinan, Yidu, Zilai, Hejian, Dongping, Nanjing, Shuntian, Shunde, Zhending, Enzhou, Gaotang, Jizhou, Beiping, and other places, this year's land tax was remitted.

s0385.literal: An edict ordered star sacrifices at the Astronomical Bureau on the equinoxes, solstices, and the emperor's birthday.
s0385.idiomatic: An edict ordered star sacrifices at the Astronomical Bureau on the equinoxes, solstices, and the emperor's birthday.

s0386.literal: An edict informed the Sichuan Branch Secretariat that border garrison soldiers who deserted would be executed.
s0386.idiomatic: An edict told the Sichuan branch secretariat that border garrison soldiers who deserted would be executed.

s0387.literal: Fengtian County in Qianzhou was reestablished; Haochi and Yongshou were abolished and incorporated into it.
s0387.idiomatic: Fengtian County in Qianzhou was reestablished; Haochi and Yongshou were abolished and absorbed into it.

s0388.literal: Fengzhou was placed under Xingyuan Route;
s0388.idiomatic: Fengzhou was placed under Xingyuan route;

s0389.literal: Dexing Prefecture was renamed Fengsheng Prefecture and placed under Xuande.
s0389.idiomatic: Dexing Prefecture was renamed Fengsheng Prefecture and placed under Xuande.

s0390.literal: That year, Jingzhao suffered severe drought.
s0390.idiomatic: That year Jingzhao suffered severe drought.

s0391.literal: Households under heaven numbered 1,650,286; sixty-nine persons were sentenced to death.
s0391.idiomatic: Households under heaven numbered 1,650,286; sixty-nine persons were sentenced to death.

s0392.literal: Gold, silver, silk currency, and cloth were granted to the princes according to the annual precedent.
s0392.idiomatic: The princes received gold, silver, silk currency, and cloth according to annual custom.

s0393.literal: Sixth year, spring, first month, on guichou day, King Wang Chon of Goryeo sent envoys to report the execution of the powerful minister Jin Jun; a calendar and western brocade were granted.
s0393.idiomatic: In the sixth year, on guichou day in the first month of spring, King Wang Chon of Goryeo sent envoys reporting the execution of the powerful minister Jin Jun; a calendar and western brocade were granted.

s0394.literal: Four branch surveillance commissions were established.
s0394.idiomatic: Four branch surveillance commissions were established.

s0395.literal: On wuwu day, Aju's army entered Song territory, reaching Fuzhou, De'an Prefecture, Jingshan and other places, captured ten thousand persons, and returned.
s0395.idiomatic: On wuwu day Aju's army entered Song territory, reaching Fuzhou, De'an Prefecture, Jingshan, and other places, captured ten thousand people, and returned.

s0396.literal: On gengshen day, Vice Grand Councillor Yang Guo was appointed Route-intendant of Huaimeng.
s0396.idiomatic: On gengshen day Vice Grand Councillor Yang Guo was made intendant of Huaimeng route.

s0397.literal: On jiaxu day, Yidu and Zilai had major floods; Enzhou suffered famine; relief was ordered.
s0397.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Yidu and Zilai suffered major floods and Enzhou famine; relief was ordered.

s0398.literal: An edict ordered Shi Tianze and Vice Director of the Military Council, the imperial son-in-law Qara Qush, to oversee the army at Xiangyang.
s0398.idiomatic: An edict ordered Shi Tianze and the imperial son-in-law Qara Qush, vice director of the Military Council, to oversee the army at Xiangyang.

s0399.literal: Second month, on renwu day, an edict was issued to all circuits concerning the establishment of four branch offices for criminal investigation and surveillance.
s0399.idiomatic: In the second month, on renwu day, an edict was issued to all circuits concerning the establishment of four branch offices for criminal investigation and surveillance.

s0400.literal: On jichou day, an edict ordered the newly devised Mongol script promulgated throughout the realm.
s0400.idiomatic: On jichou day an edict ordered the newly devised Mongol script promulgated throughout the realm.
